correctness.rationale: For equivalences R,S on a labelled finite set, relational compositions RS and SR coincide exactly when their existential powerset modalities commute (singletons determine relation); in that case RS is their join equivalence R∨S. Each connected join block consists of r row R-classes and s column S-classes with all rs intersections nonempty; conversely such positive rectangular cell grids force commutation. On a labelled j-set, the number of such structures is (rs)! S(j,rs)/(r!s!), with nonempty-cell exponential weight (e^z-1)^(rs)/(r!s!). The labelled SET construction of join-blocks yields exp(t sum_{r,s>=1}u^r v^s (e^z-1)^(rs)/(r!s!)), and the composite modal image consists exactly of all unions of c join blocks, hence 2^c outputs. For c=1 at least ab points needed; c>=2 minimizing sum_i r_i s_i gives n>=a+b-c, achievable by two single-sided thick blocks plus (c-2) singleton blocks. Require 1<=c<=min(a,b); n=0 single empty pair. Independently generated set partitions and tested relational commutation for n=0..4: total 1,1,4,19,117, agreeing with OEIS; separately reconstructed sharp support algebra. Finite enumeration does not replace full labelled species proof.
